# Generated sources -- see README.md in this directory and
# tools/portable/datagen.py.  Regenerate with:
#   python tools/portable/datagen.py
# game_data.[ch]/game_state.[ch] are committed (not build-generated by CMake)
# so a normal checkout builds without running Python; datagen.py is only
# needed when recipes/data/game-initialized.json, src/data/GAME_BSS.json,
# layout/production-plan.json, layout/manifest.json, docs/current/symbol-names.json,
# tools/portable/state_ownership.json, or the extern `/* DS:XXXX */` comments
# in src/*.C / include/*.H change.
target_sources(empires_core PRIVATE
    game_data.c
    game_data.h
    game_state.c
    game_state.h
)
target_include_directories(empires_core PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
